method.title: Our method in 3 steps

profile.title: 1. Your ESN profile
profile.body: Your priority sectors, the account size you target and your offers weight every company's score without you ticking a single box.

market.title: 2. Market signals
market.body: Company registry, open and awarded public tenders, job postings. Every signal comes with its date and its source link: no date, no signal.

score.title: 3. Score and recommendation
score.body: Eight criteria scored separately — line of business, geography, headcount, company age, IT surface, dated signals, accessibility and evidence quality. A criterion with no data is not scored zero: it leaves the scale and is flagged on the card.

method.footer: Exploring is free: only a full account analysis starts real background work.
